title: Add extraction/chunking/indexing

context.summary: Create text/Markdown extraction, deterministic chunking, embedding provider interfaces and vector index scaffolding.
context.background: TASK-8 added document upload and scan flow. TASK-9 adds the next document-processing capabilities while avoiding concrete DB repositories and search endpoints.

in: Define extraction, chunking, embedding and vector index contracts in @mindory/core.
Implement a deterministic text chunker in @mindory/core.
Implement built-in text and Markdown extraction for .txt, .md and .markdown files.
Add OpenAI-compatible and Ollama embedding provider package implementations over fetch.
Add pgvector adapter placeholder with explicit not-implemented behavior.
Add Qdrant adapter placeholder alignment if needed for vector package consistency.
Add extraction/chunking/indexing validation to repository checks.
Update document pipeline, architecture, worker and configuration docs.
out: Add database migrations for vector index tables.
Implement memory claim derivation or context builder.
Wire processors into a running worker.
Run embedding providers, pgvector or Qdrant against live services.
Install dependencies if pnpm is unavailable in the local environment.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/core exports TextExtractor, TextChunker, EmbeddingsProvider and VectorIndex contracts.
@mindory/core exports a deterministic fixed-size text chunker.
@mindory/extractor-builtin-text extracts UTF-8 text and Markdown content from supported MIME types/extensions.
@mindory/embeddings-openai-compatible exports a provider that calls an OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint.
@mindory/embeddings-ollama exports a provider that calls Ollama /api/embed.
@mindory/vector-pgvector exports a pgvector adapter scaffold that clearly reports vector_index_not_implemented until schema/repository work is added.
No concrete chunk repository, vector DB migration, document search endpoint, memory derivation or context builder is implemented.

manual_checks: Confirm text chunking is deterministic and bounded.
Confirm pgvector remains an explicit scaffold rather than a fake index implementation.
Confirm no document search endpoint, memory derivation or context builder was added.

risks: Local pnpm is unavailable in the current environment, so TypeScript execution may need to wait until dependencies are installed.
Embedding and vector adapters are not exercised against live providers in this task.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
